identification: Small oil painting of Cradle Mountain and Dove Lake, Tasmania, signed lower left 'O.C. GARNER' (Olga Garner, Tasmanian landscape painter). Classic view from the Dove Lake shore with autumn-toned scrub, dead snags at right, snow patches on the peaks. Image about 19 x 24 cm (per catalogue), in a wide gilt/wood frame with a linen slip. Realist, finely detailed style typical of Tasmanian tourist-market landscapes from the 1970s-90s.
